targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (elasticsearch_cluster_status{instance="$instance", status="yellow"}) + 2 * sum by (cluster) (elasticsearch_cluster_status{instance="$instance", status="red"})

panels.title: Cluster status (0=green, 1=yellow, 2=red)
panels.description: Encoded cluster health: 0=green, 1=yellow, 2=red (from sticky 0/1 status triad).

panels.title: Index status (green/yellow/red)
panels.description: Sticky status emits green/yellow/red as 0/1 gauges; == 1 keeps only the active status per index.

targets.expr: sum by (index) (rate(elasticsearch_total_search{key="query_time_in_millis", instance="$instance"}[$interval])) / sum by (index) (rate(elasticsearch_total_search{key="query_total", instance="$instance"}[$interval]))

sum by (index) (rate(elasticsearch_total_indexing{key="index_time_in_millis", instance="$instance"}[$interval])) / sum by (index) (rate(elasticsearch_total_indexing{key="index_total", instance="$instance"}[$interval]))

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Host disk I/O from Alligator system { disk; }: disk_io{dev,type} (transfers_*/bytes_*). Prefer this over elasticsearch_fs_io_stat_total.
